A '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], and under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="Rising" />

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] participated in the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|Battle of Abregado]]. After the arrival of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] fleet, this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] reported the detection of three [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|cruisers]] to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who ordered it to jam their communication.<ref name="Rising" />
